limits: Read-only public RPC + Dexscreener; this wallet is never copied into the paper books and nothing is signed.
Value history starts at the first dashboard snapshot (no historical backfill).
USD total includes only holdings with a liquid Dexscreener pool (same $5K quote-side rule as paper marks); unpriced tokens are listed but not valued.
Native SOL is the system-account spendable balance (rent locked in token accounts is not included).
Recent swaps are inferred from on-chain token deltas on the last 15 signatures and can miss complex routes.
Public RPCs may rate-limit; a failed fetch keeps the last snapshot and flags the view as stale.
